newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown/dollar at 26.229 (26.052).
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown/dollar at 26.229 (26.052).

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown at 26.229 to the dollar after Monday's fixing at 26.052, and at 17.628 to the mark from 17.564.
The CNB said the bid/ask, which applies only to traders dealing with the central bank, was 26.163/295 to the dollar and 17.584/672 for the mark.
The crown fixing is announced daily at about 1140 CET (0940 GMT) and is within plus/minus 7.5 percent of a dollar/mark basket midpoint calculated between 11:30:00 and 11:30:59 CET.
The above rates imply a deviation from the midpoint of +4.05 percent, down from a deviation of +4.50 on Monday.
